description: Stage 2a complete: chi=3 multicritical MERA at the O'Brien-Fendley TCI point (lam3/lamI=0.856). Optimization plateaued at rel_err ~0.42%; this record evaluates the c=7/10 sufficiency gate on the converged checkpoint.

results.verdict_SUPERSEDED_2026_06_16: chi=3 INSUFFICIENT for the multicritical TCI point: energy plateaued at rel_err 0.341% (floor), GS-overlap 0.9256, half-chain entanglement S_mera=0.000 vs S_exact=0.179 (ratio 0.001 -- chi=3 UNDERSHOOTS the entanglement the c=7/10 state carries). ESCALATE to chi>=4. The HYP-027 universality question requires the higher-chi run; chi=3 stage-2 is a clean NEGATIVE on sufficiency, not on the physics.
